raw_response:
Alright, let me think this through. I'm sitting here at the start of the season, wheat already in the ground from last October, cotton time coming up, maize still two months off.

---

**My thinking, crop by crop:**

I've got 16.9 mu split three ways. My west plot — about 5 mu, sandier soil, not the best for wheat — I keep in cotton every year. The rest, about 11.9 mu of better ground, goes wheat-maize double crop like most folks in the village. That's how I've done it for twenty-some years and it works.

**Wheat** (already planted last October, about 11.9 mu): I used my own saved seed plus a bag of improved variety I bought at the co-op, Jimai type, what the ag station recommended. Before planting I put down about 40 kg of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) per mu — that's my base. Now in April, wheat is at jointing. I'll topdress about 12-13 kg of urea per mu with the spring irrigation. The extension guy tells us 15 kg of pure N is enough, but I figure a little extra won't hurt — I'd rather spend 20 yuan more than lose 50 kg of grain. Total N ends up around 16-17 kg/mu. I'll irrigate three times: green-up in March (already done), jointing now, and again at filling in May. Pumping costs me about 30 yuan per mu per round, so that adds up. One spray of herbicide at green-up, and if I see aphids late I'll spray once more. Expecting about 450 kg/mu — last year I got 470 but the spring was kinder.

**Maize** (to plant mid-June after wheat harvest, 11.9 mu): Tight turnaround, usually less than a week between combining wheat and getting maize in the ground. I don't till — I use the no-till planter the cooperative rents out, drills right through the wheat stubble. Zhengdan 958 hybrid seed, about 40 yuan/mu. I'll put down 30 kg of compound fertilizer with the seed and topdress 15 kg of urea at big trumpet stage. If July is dry I'll irrigate once, maybe twice — hopefully the rains come. One herbicide spray after planting. Expecting 500 kg/mu, same as usual.

**Cotton** (planting late April, 5 mu): This is the trickier crop. Prices have been so-so, but I keep growing it because that west field doesn't do well for grain and the household needs some cash crop. I'll plant in a week or so once the soil warms up. Local variety, cover with plastic mulch like everyone does here. Compound fertilizer 30 kg/mu at planting, urea 15 kg/mu at squaring. Need to spray for bollworm and aphids probably 3-4 times over the summer — cotton is the spray-heavy crop. Irrigate twice if the summer is dry. Picking starts in September, goes into October, family helps — my wife and daughter-in-law do most of the picking, takes forever. Expecting 250 kg/mu lint.

**Money and labor:** Total input costs run me around 15,000 yuan for the year. Two of my sons work in town so it's me, my wife, and sometimes my daughter-in-law in the fields. I hire a combine for wheat harvest and a picker I rent for cotton. For 16.9 mu at my age, that's about all I can handle.
